CustomField.description: Custom field, created to fix the CPQ bug about wrong values in the OOTB field Volume Discount. Displays the volume discount in % if discount schedule tiers are defined in %. Displays the volume discount in amount if discount schedule tiers are defined in amount.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(SBQQ__DiscountSchedule__c), null, IF( AND (NOT(ISBLANK(SBQQ__DiscountTier__c)),TEXT(SBQQ__DiscountSchedule__r.SBQQ__DiscountUnit__c) = "Percent"), TEXT(SBQQ__VolumeDiscount__c *10000/SBQQ__ListPrice__c) + "%", IF( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(SBQQ__DiscountTier__c)),TEXT(SBQQ__DiscountSchedule__r.SBQQ__DiscountUnit__c) = "Amount"), TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode) + ' ' + TEXT(SBQQ__VolumeDiscount__c * 100), TEXT(SBQQ__VolumeDiscount__c) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Volume Discount
